content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

Intervention for Mixed AS and AR: Mitral valve repair with aortic valve replacement is superior to double valve replacement.

Intervention for Mixed MS and MR: Mitral valve repair with aortic valve replacement is superior to double valve replacement.

Diagnosis and Follow-Up: Doppler echocardiography is crucial for follow-up.
Transcatheter and surgical aortic valves show different outcomes.

Selection of Prosthetic Valve Type: Mechanical or biologic prostheses for aortic and mitral valve replacement are recommended.
